fieldValues.title: A third forward reference beyond the two srs#690 named: Travelling form -> Foundational tension
fieldValues.summary: Placing Foundational tension and Semantic sovereignty in Governance (their natural home, matching the sibling Foundational values and development phase concept already there) conflicts with an existing depends-on edge from Travelling form (a child of Repository, which belongs in Distribution) to Foundational tension: Governance is the last Part in root-container order, so nothing outside Governance may depend on something inside it. srs#690's body names only two forward references to fix (Semantic order -> Projection, Graduation -> Relation); this third one was found only by running check-spec-coherence.mjs after placing all 25 concepts. Resolved the same way as the first named case: dropped the depends-on edge (Travelling form's own text keeps the mention as a contrast, no content change), rather than inventing a third remedy.
evidence: check-spec-coherence.mjs reported '"Travelling form" is introduced before "Foundational tension" but depends on it' once Foundational tension/Semantic sovereignty were parented under Governance

Deleting the edge is verified: check-spec-coherence.mjs exits 0 afterward with part-order non-vacuous (0 edges pointing forward) and re-adding the edge as a deliberate test reproduces the red no-forward-reference/part-order output
